name: Cerave Hydrating Cleanser Face Wash 473Ml, for rmal to Dry Skin, Hyaluronic Acid
description: Our hydrating cleanser was developed as a hydrating face wash for those looking for a gentle yet thorough cleanse that won’t leave skin feeling tight or dry. In fact, our unique blend of three essential ceramides and hyaluronic acid also helps nourish and hydrate skin while helping to restore and maintain its essential natural moisture barrier. To help skin reap all the benefits that this hydrating cleanser provides, our MVE Delivery Technology encapsulates ceramides to ensure efficient delivery within the skin’s barrier and slowly releases them over time—supporting it long after you’ve rinsed this face wash for dry skin away. It is dermatologist-recommended to help repair the skin barrier.
